name: Akechi Hanako
source:
Childhood neighbor to Ryuu and the twins. She is extremely shy and not very good at advocating herself. She betrayed Mikuru's trust a few years ago, and ever since has been trying to win it back. In an attempt at that, she attended their university.
Her brother went deaf from the same pile-up that gave Ryuu PTSD.

Favorite Color: Grey
Blood Type: B-
